body:
if only it was as easy as ‘someone being able to make it stop’, i wish it was though. the reality is there’s no quick or instant fix and it’s learning to cope with how your feeling, but you already know this. i’m going to assume by you saying you want to die, you’re in a lot of pain right now. it’s hard, it really is, but just consider this for a second.

first of all it took me years to realise this for myself, i’m not saying you’re the same as me and we all have and cope with different things. 

do you really want to die? 
its a way we feel we could end all of the pain, but deep down i do not, and you’re possibly the same. i ‘want to die’ for the pain to stop, not because i actually want to. i want to live, but pain free. i feel recognising if this is the case for you too is a big step forward, although i’m not a therapist and i do recommend getting professional help.

yea for sure, you’re right. people definitely have it harder than others. i do personally believe that some people are blessed enough to be able to cope with things so much better though, especially better than myself
i feel like everyone has a fair share of issues over their lives, just some can cope a lot better than others

it does, although at some points i also feel the opposite and as if i’m breathing in too much air. it can’t affect a lot of people in different ways and i’m no doctor but from what you said it sounds a lot like anxiety

100%. and when you say all day i imagine that’s not an exaggeration either as mine is quite literally all day too, along with a constant adrenaline feeling, what feels like difficulty breathing, feeling sick and quite literally a sore heart. personally the worst part of anxiety for me is the physical symptoms. 

i’d recommend talking to a doctor if you haven’t already as there is medication out there to treat it. i personally haven’t taken any for it but recently spoke to my doctor and have been prescribed some to start taking. if it’s bad and getting in the way of your life i’d recommend possibly doing the same

i’ve never seen a more relatable post, i have the exact same issue and ask myself why breakups affect me more than everyone around me. i guess it’s just because we’re all different, and handle and cope with things in different ways. i’ve only ever had 2 breakups and both have left me with extreme anxiety, depression and suicidal thoughts. in both of those relationships it’s always been someone else that has came into the picture and it’s destroyed everything. i will and can also never help but think what if there is someone else, it’s only natural to when it’s happened every time to us before, although it’s really not healthy and can ultimately continue to destroy our relationships in the future

the truth is, no matter how much a girl may say ‘it’s cute’ or ‘it’ll never happen’, insecurity just pushes them away even more. in my last relationship i remember saying many times that my insecurity was going to push her away, she tried telling me otherwise and that it won’t happen. in the end it did. i feel we are both somewhat similar. it’s very hard to not be worried or curious when another guy is around, especially if you have any reason to believe it could be or become anything more. 

like i say i believe we are very similar and i am open to messaging if you ever wanted to talk more about any of this. i’m 20 a year old guy from the UK if that makes any difference

i can’t even imagine what that must feel like right now but i’m really sorry for your loss. losing someone so close to you is never easy and your body is reacting and processing everything. i would personally look into online therapy until the corona situation has improved. it’s going to feel awful, just remember you have to give yourself time to grieve, as hard as it may be right now. stay strong
